questions.q:
A: How ____ do you go shopping?
B: Once a week.
questions.zh:
A: 你多久去購物一次？
B: 一個禮拜一次。
questions.explain: How often（問次數與頻率）。

questions.q: ____ are you younger than your brother? I am two years younger than my brother.
questions.zh: 你比你的哥哥小幾歲？我比我哥哥小兩歲。
questions.explain: How old 用於詢問年紀；How many years 用於詢問年歲差距。

questions.q: ____ are there in your collection? There are 500 stamps in my collection.
questions.zh: 你的集郵簿裡有多少張郵票？我的集郵簿裡有 500 張。
questions.explain: How many ＋ 複數名詞，stamp 為可數名詞，故用 how many stamps。

questions.q: ____ is it from the bank to the post office?
questions.zh: 從銀行到郵局有多遠？
questions.explain: How far is it...? 用於詢問距離。

questions.q: She got up ____ this morning.
questions.zh: 她今天早上很晚起床。
questions.explain: late 為副詞，意為「遲；晚」，修飾 got up（起床）。lately 意為「最近地」。

questions.q: She is always very ____ dressed.
questions.zh: 她總是穿著非常整齊。
questions.explain: dressed 為過去分詞轉化之形容詞，故需用副詞 neatly（整齊地）來修飾。

questions.q: I am ____ interested in the news.
questions.zh: 我對這則消息深感興趣。
questions.explain: interested 為形容詞（感興趣的），需用副詞 deeply（深深地）修飾。

questions.q: He ____ in a traffic accident.
questions.zh: 他在車禍中受到重傷。
questions.explain: 人 ＋ be injured 表「某人受傷」；副詞 badly（嚴重地）置於 be 動詞與過去分詞 injured 之間。

questions.q: Tony is used to ____ for his girl friend Sue.
questions.zh: 湯尼習慣於耐心地等待他的女朋友蘇。
questions.explain:
① be used to ＋ V-ing（習慣於…）。
② 用副詞 patiently（耐心地）修飾動詞 wait。

questions.q: We can learn ____ than ever.
questions.zh: 我們學習起來比以前容易得多。
questions.explain: 副詞比較級 more easily（較容易地）修飾動詞 learn，其前可用 much 修飾比較級。

questions.q: You have been ____ with your sister.
questions.zh: 你已經對你妹妹無理地發脾氣。
questions.explain: 句型為 be ＋ 副詞 ＋ 形容詞。unreasonably（無理地，副詞）修飾形容詞 angry。

questions.q: It is such a good opportunity ____ you should not miss it.
questions.zh: 這樣的好機會你不該錯過。
questions.explain: such a/an ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句（如此…以致於…）。

questions.q: Mr. Jones was ____ angry to say anything at all.
questions.zh: 瓊斯先生氣得說不出話來。
questions.explain: too ＋ 形容詞／副詞 ＋ to V（太…而不能…）。

questions.q: A fur coat is ____ more expensive than a cotton dress.
questions.zh: 一件皮大衣比一件棉布衣貴得多。
questions.explain: much ／ far ＋ 比較級（比…得多）。very 不能直接修飾比較級。

questions.q: Winter in the south are ____ like those in southern California.
questions.zh: 南方的冬天和加州南部非常相像。
questions.explain: be like（像…）➜ be very like...（非常像…）。

questions.q: Atomic energy plays an ____ important role in industry.
questions.zh: 原子能可在工業上逐漸扮演重要角色。
questions.explain:
① play an important role（扮演重要角色）。
② increasingly（逐漸地）為副詞，修飾形容詞 important。

questions.q: Nylon is also smooth and washes even ____ than silk.
questions.zh: 尼龍也是很光滑的，而且比絲更易洗。
questions.explain: 副詞比較級 more easily（較容易地）修飾動詞 washes，even 可用來加強比較級。

questions.q: The more you learn, the more ____ you can get a job.
questions.zh: 你學得愈多，你愈容易找到工作。
questions.explain:
① The ＋ 比較級..., the ＋ 比較級...（愈…愈…）。
② 此處用副詞 easily（容易地）修飾動詞 get。

questions.q: ____ you did not come yesterday?
questions.zh: 為何你昨天沒來？
questions.explain: How come ＋ S ＋ V...?（為何…？），後面接直述句語序。

questions.q: Great minds ____.
questions.zh: 英雄所見略同。
questions.explain: think alike（想法相似），alike 為副詞，修飾動詞 think；主詞 minds 為複數，動詞用原形 think。

questions.q: For ____ he lived in the south of Europe for the sake of his health.
questions.zh: 有段時間，他因健康的緣故住在南歐。
questions.explain: some time [名詞片語] 有一段時間；sometime [副詞] 某一時刻；some times [名詞片語] 好幾次；sometimes [副詞] 偶爾、有時候。

questions.q: When they met again a few years later, they said that they were ____ young.
questions.zh: 幾年後當他們再次相逢，他們都說他們不再年輕了。
questions.explain: no longer 意為「不再」。

questions.q: ____ the male are more beautiful than the female in the world of animals.
questions.zh: 動物的世界中，通常雄性比雌性漂亮。
questions.explain: 頻率副詞（usually）放在句首，是為了加強語氣。

questions.q: Everyone who went on that trip returned full of tales which were talked about for months ____.
questions.zh: 去那次旅行的人都帶著好多的故事回來，這些故事在後來幾個月中被談論著。
questions.explain: for months later（在之後的數月間）。(A) latter 後者；(B) latest 最晚的、最新的；(D) late 遲的、晚的。

questions.q: One point is that if the assignment is worked out ____, the worker will gain a power that would not be possible otherwise.
questions.zh: 有一點就是如果該項作業已經徹底地計劃好，那麼工人就會獲得一種力量，反之就不可能的。
questions.explain: work out（精細計劃）為動詞片語，所以選用 thoroughly（徹底地，副詞）來修飾。

questions.q: As he could not come ____, he sent his younger brother instead.（複選）
questions.zh: 因為他不能親自來，便叫他弟弟代替他來。
questions.explain: himself、in person、personally 皆可表示「親自」。by himself ＝ alone（獨自），與題意不合。

questions.q: After the fight, a caretaker found that a young man ____ so he telephoned for an ambulance immediately.
questions.zh: 在一場打鬥之後，管理員發現有一位年輕人受傷很嚴重，所以他立刻打電話叫救護車。
questions.explain:
① that 引導名詞子句做 found 的受詞。
② a young man 是名詞子句的主詞，述語動詞是 was injured（受傷），副詞 seriously（嚴重地）放在動詞片語的中間。

questions.q:
A: Do you postpone your trip to America?
B: Yes, I ____ until next year.
questions.zh:
A: 你到美國的旅行要延期嗎？
B: 是的，我要延到明年。
questions.explain:
① 用 “it” 代替提過的名詞（my trip）。
② put off ＝ postpone（延期）。
③ “it” 為代名詞，與 put off 連用時，應改為 put it off。

questions.q:
"How can I get there very fast?"
"You will get there ____ if you go by taxi."
questions.zh: 「我要如何才能快點到達那裡？」「坐計程車會快點到。」
questions.explain: 單音節副詞 fast，比較級加 -er 成為 faster；多音節副詞才加 more。

questions.q: We ought to prepare ourselves against a rainy day as ____.
questions.zh: 我們應該未雨綢繆，盡量做好準備。
questions.explain:
① as... as possible（儘量；盡可能）。
② a rainy day（未雨綢繆；不時之需）。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填空題
sections.instructions: 依中文提示完成下列英文句子，每格限填一字

questions.q:
天氣太冷而無法游泳。
It was ____ cold ____ we ____ swim.
questions.zh: 天氣太冷而無法游泳。
questions.explain: so... that... can't/couldn't...（如此…以致於無法…）。本句亦可寫成 It is/was too cold to swim。

questions.q:
無論這工作有多難，我都要完成它。
____ ____ the work ____, I will finish it.
questions.zh: 無論這工作有多難，我都要完成它。
questions.explain: However ＋ 形容詞／副詞 ＋ S ＋ V（無論多麼…）。

questions.q:
這本書太難了，我讀不懂。
The book is ____ hard ____ I can't read ____.
questions.zh: 這本書太難了，我讀不懂。
questions.explain: so... that...（如此…以致於…）。注意 read 之後需補上受詞 it 指代 the book。

questions.q:
他之所以有今天的地位，全靠工作勤奮。
He is ____ he is ____ ____ ____.
questions.zh: 他之所以有今天的地位，全靠工作勤奮。
questions.explain: what (人) is 指「一個人的現狀或地位、人品」；by working hard 表示「藉由努力工作」。

questions.q:
我很忙，所以必須把假期延後幾天。
I am ____ busy ____ I'll have to ____ my vacation ____ for a few days.
questions.zh: 我很忙，所以必須把假期延後幾天。
questions.explain: so... that...（如此…以致於…）；put... off（把…延期）。

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成通順的英文

questions.q: 秋天是我最喜歡出外旅遊的季節。
questions.hint: 出外旅遊：go on a trip
answer: Fall is the season when I like to go on an outing best.
Autumn is the season when I like to go on an outing best.
Fall is the season when I like to go on a trip best.
Autumn is the season when I like to go on a trip best.
questions.zh: 秋天是我最喜歡出外旅遊的季節。
questions.explain:
「出外郊遊／旅遊」：go on an outing 或 go on a picnic / go on a trip。
when 引導關係副詞子句修飾先行詞 the season。

questions.q: 每年秋天我都去阿里山，那裡空氣非常新鮮。
questions.answer: Every fall I go to Mt. Ali, where the air is fresh.
questions.zh: 每年秋天我都去阿里山，那裡空氣非常新鮮。
questions.explain: where 為關係副詞，引導非限定關係子句修飾專有名詞 Mt. Ali。

questions.q: 而我常去那裡的原因是觀賞迷人的日出。
questions.answer: The reason why I often go there is that I enjoy watching the fascinating sunrise.
questions.zh: 而我常去那裡的原因是觀賞迷人的日出。
questions.explain:
①「迷人的」：fascinating, charming, attractive。
② why 為關係副詞修飾 the reason；that 引導名詞子句作 is 的主詞補語。

questions.q: 一大清早，山上擠滿了遊客等待太陽的出現。
questions.hint: 擠滿了遊客：be crowded with travellers
answer: In the early morning, the mountain top is crowded with visitors waiting for the sun to come up.
In the early morning, the mountain top is crowded with travellers waiting for the sun to come up.
questions.zh: 一大清早，山上擠滿了遊客等待太陽的出現。
questions.explain:
①「擠滿」：be crowded with / be filled with。
② waiting for the sun to come up 為分詞片語修飾前面的 visitors / travellers。

questions.q: 他們直到看見閃亮的太陽才高興地下山。
answer: They don't go down the mountain happily until they have seen the shining sun.
They don't go down the mountain happily until they have seen the sparkling sun.
questions.zh: 他們直到看見閃亮的太陽才高興地下山。
questions.explain:
「直到…才…」：not... until...。
happily（高興地，副詞）修飾動詞片語 go down the mountain。

sections.title: （五）選答案填充
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文，並在空格內填入最適當的單字：

There is one interesting fact a__1.__ the shark. Perhaps you know __2.__. It never stops swimming. If it __3.__, it would sink in the water. It is not like o__4.__ fish which can stop swimming and rest.

Though the shark is dangerous, fishermen still hunt __5.__ it in the sea. They can sell i__6.__ oil. It is called "shark's liver oil" and __7.__ rich in vitamin A. __8.__ certain countries, shark's meat is e__9.__. So fishermen can sell the shark __10.__ a lot of money.

【詞彙及短語提示】
1. the shark：鯊魚
2. perhaps：也許
3. sink [動]：下沉
4. dangerous [形]：危險的
5. shark's liver oil：魚肝油
6. fishermen [名]：漁夫

questions.q: There is one interesting fact a____ the shark.
questions.zh: 關於鯊魚有一個有趣的事實。
questions.explain: about（關於）。fact about... 意為「關於…的事實」。

questions.q: Perhaps you know ____.
questions.zh: 也許你已經知道這件事。
questions.explain: 代名詞 it 指代前面所提的 fact。

questions.q: If it ____, it would sink in the water.
questions.zh: 如果牠停止游泳，牠就會沉入水中。
questions.explain: 與現在事實相反的假設語氣：if 子句用過去式動詞 stopped，主要子句用 would ＋ 原形動詞 sink。

questions.q: It is not like o____ fish which can stop swimming and rest.
questions.zh: 牠不像其他可以停止游泳並休息的魚類。
questions.explain: other ＋ 複數名詞（其他…）。fish 單複數同形，在此表複數。

questions.q: Though the shark is dangerous, fishermen still hunt ____ it in the sea.
questions.zh: 雖然鯊魚很危險，漁夫們仍在海中獵捕牠。
questions.explain: hunt for...（獵捕…；搜尋…）。

questions.q: They can sell i____ oil.
questions.zh: 他們可以賣牠的油。
questions.explain: 所有格代名詞 its（牠的），修飾名詞 oil。

questions.q: It is called "shark's liver oil" and ____ rich in vitamin A.
questions.zh: 它被稱為「魚肝油」，並且富含維生素 A。
questions.explain: 主詞為 It（單數），be rich in...（富含…），動詞用 is。

questions.q: ____ certain countries, shark's meat is eaten.
questions.zh: 在某些國家，鯊魚肉是被食用的。
questions.explain: 在某個國家介系詞用 In，置於句首字首需大寫。

questions.q: ...shark's meat is e____.
questions.zh: …鯊魚肉是被食用的。
questions.explain: is eaten 為被動語態（被吃、被食用），eat 的過去分詞為 eaten。

questions.q: So fishermen can sell the shark ____ a lot of money.
questions.zh: 因此漁夫們可以把鯊魚賣得很多錢。
questions.explain: sell something for + 金額（以…價錢出售某物）。
